protocol: FedBCert E20 identity-null certified structural residual
purpose: remove the E19 graph-independent capacity confound and test whether observed local structure contributes utility

identity_null_contract.identity_shift_fused_logits: exactly equal to graph-invariant feature-expert logits
identity_null_contract.completion_radius: unchanged because the invariant -H term cancels between completions

selection_rule.eligible_variants: one global nonzero alpha; no dataset-specific routing
selection_rule.objective: maximum mean observed-minus-identity validation Macro-F1 among feasible global alphas

confirmation_claims.primary_estimand: observed P minus identity P pooled test Macro-F1

fixed_hyperparameters.federated_optimizer: standard FedAvg weighted by labelled local training count

prohibited_actions: using seeds 87-89 before an E20a proceed decision
changing the identity-null formula after viewing validation or confirmation metrics
dropping a dataset because observed P underperforms I
using confirmation test metrics for model or certificate selection
